name: Alpha Jump
description: Changes the Jellyfin Web alphabet picker into a direct scroll to matching Movies and Shows without filtering the rendered library.
overview: Plex-style alphabet jumping for supported Jellyfin Web Movies and Shows libraries without native alphabet filtering.
